title: Hub view has a Tasks mode: goal → task cards with recent updates instead of terminals, on the Mac grid and the phone Status tab

requirements.text: The Mac grid has a CLI | Tasks toggle; in Tasks every pane shows its session's goal → task, proof progress and recent updates, and no terminal or agent prose

requirements.text: Tasks mode also has a whole-system board: every project's active goals → their open tasks with latest update, or one project's when a project's grid is shown
